question: The composer's model picker rendered disabled as 'Models, Auto': either OMP advertises no models (provider/credentials) or our bridge drops them.
answer: OMP advertises the models and the bridge's normalizers were correct; the read had no OMP process to answer it, because the probe session's runtime was never started.

measured.method: host HTTP API with the descriptor at ~/Library/Application Support/Caret/host/host.json (token never printed)
measured.noteOnStatus: host record status `idle` does not mean the OMP process is up: a session that answers the catalog and one that refuses it both read `idle`

catalogBeforeStart.error: Start or reconcile the OMP session before sending commands

measured.secondBug: after POST /start the incarnation changes; a command sent with the pre-start incarnation is refused with HTTP 409 stale_incarnation, so the retry must read the session that start returned

change.helper: snapshotWithOmpRuntime(client, session, log): read the catalog once; on not_dispatched start that session once and read again with the returned incarnation; a host failure returns the empty snapshot without starting; a failed start falls back to the refused answer
change.reuse: fetchOmpModelSnapshot gained an optional `catalog` command so an already-read answer is not asked twice
change.noSecondPath: the catalog is still read through the same OMP RPC path the harness owns; no separate CLI or cache reader was added
change.cost: one OMP process on the first picker read of a window that has never sent a prompt - the same process the first prompt would start, and the host keeps it

unit: refused read -> start -> retry carries the new incarnation (inc-live) and yields the model
warm read -> startSession must not be called, and exactly one get_available_models is sent
host down -> no start, empty snapshot
suites: bun test apps/macos/test packages/omp-adapter packages/relay apps/host -> 740 pass (737 before)
verified.liveHost: after the fix 3 sessions answer the catalog (1 before, started by hand)
onScreen: session opened in the packaged app: .model-picker-split rect 139x22, disabled false, label 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash'

real click on the picker: list box with 'Search models', 'Current model' mark, and rows DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Command Code) / Grok 4.6 / GPT-5.6-Luna / GPT-6-Astra / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor

notVerified: the draft composer (no session open) still renders model-picker-split at 0x0 and disabled - that is the new-chat widget's own state, not the catalog; whether the empty home should show the catalog is undecided

a fresh install with zero host sessions has nothing to probe, so it stays honest-empty; showing models before any work would need a session-less catalog read (a host-owned route, or OMP's models.db cache)
set_model write-through was not exercised end to end in this pass (the write-through itself and its tests predate this change)
OMP's own `omp models` CLI output was not compared - this pass deliberately used the harness RPC path only

artifacts.excerpts: menu row labels and the model counts above are the only data recorded; no token, no provider credential and no session content was captured
